name: AI Auto Content Publisher Lite
author: miaomiao1

sections.description:
Tired of writing product promotion articles manually? Let AI do the heavy lifting! AI Auto Content Publisher Lite automates your WordPress content creation process.

This lite version works with the powerful OpenAI GPT-4o-mini model to generate high-quality, relevant text based on your configuration.

Free Version Features for the US market:

  • Powerful OpenAI Integration: Directly connects to GPT-4o-mini AI model.
  • Single Configuration: Enter product link, custom prompt, keywords, and optional image.
  • Dynamic Keyword Rotation: Random keyword replacement for content diversity.
  • Flexible Post Status: Draft, published, or pending.
  • Smart Scheduling: Daily or manual posting.
  • Manual Trigger: Limited to once per 24 hours.
  • Advanced Image Handling: Featured image or appended inside content.
  • User-Friendly Interface: Simple settings page and activity log.

Upgrade to Pro for:
– Multiple AI models (including GPT-4 and DeepSeek)
– Unlimited configurations
– Advanced scheduling
– More…

Pro version: AI Auto Content Publisher for WordPress

External Services

Uses OpenAI API https://api.openai.com/v1/chat/completions.
sections.installation:
1. Upload ai-auto-content-publisher-lite folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate the plugin in the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings > AI Content Lite.
  4. Enter your OpenAI API key (sk-... format).
  5. Configure product link, prompt, keywords, image, and publishing rules.
  6. Save settings.

  • Updated descriptions/changelog to reflect the new AI model.

2.0.0

  • Major change from Tongyi Qwen to OpenAI GPT models.
